description: Concept-to-path bridge for the normalized layer of the VRK election corpus. For each concept, the normalized dotted path per election id. An election missing from a concept's paths does not publish (or does not normalize) that concept — see docs/DATA_GUIDE.md.
verified: 2026-08-19 against every record of the 20 elections then under data/; 2026-08-21 for the six 2015 elections added since, against their parsed records (complete fields for the three small ones, fixture sets for the three large ones). 2026-08-21 for the five 1996-1998 archive elections added since: the two municipal ones (1997-kovo-23-savivaldybiu-tarybu, 1997-birzelio-29-svenciniu-tarybos-pakartotiniai) against their parsed records for the ten concepts their anketa/kandidatavimas sections actually publish (kebab-case keys shared with the 2015 and 2016 eras, so no era-specific path shape); the three Seimas archive elections (1996-spalio-20-seimo and its two 1997 repeats) publish none of the existing concepts — no birth date, nationality, education, or any of the other fields those pages simply do not carry, and their candidacy field is a list (single- and multi-mandate seats can both apply) rather than the single value every existing concept path assumes, so iskele/savivaldybe are left unmapped for them too — so they appear only in the elections list. 2026-08-21 for the four 2012-2014 elections (2012-seimo, 2013-kovo-3-seimo-birzai-zarasai-ukmerge, 2014-prezidento, 2014-ep): same era and key set as the 2015 elections, paths copied from 2015-kovo-1-seimo-zirmunai and validated against every parsed record; the presidential election maps no iskele (self-nominated) and no ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu (its form asks the eligibility set, not Q9.2), the EP election no kita-apie-save (no Q21), and neither 2014 election a declaration period (their note paragraph is empty). 2026-08-22 for 2009-prezidento: the 2014 presidential paths copied and validated against all seven parsed records (same concept set — no iskele, no ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu, no declaration period). Same day for 2009-ep: the 2014 EP paths (plus kita-apie-save, which its Q21 publishes) validated against the fifteen fixture records. Same day for 2008-seimo: the 2012 Seimo paths validated against the eight fixture records. Same day for the 2009 and 2011 Seimo by-elections: the 2013 paths validated against their complete fields (17 and 9 records). Same day for 2007-spalio-7-seimo-dzukija: the 2013 paths validated against its complete field (10 records); gimimo-data resolves through anketa because the era parser folds the card's date in. Same day for 2011-vasario-27-savivaldybiu: the 2015 municipal general's paths validated against the ten fixture records (same era, same municipal key set; the election adds no concept of its own). Same day for 2007-vasario-25-savivaldybiu: the 2011 municipal general's paths validated against the ten fixture records; savivaldybe resolves through kandidatavimas (the 2007 card names the electoral district, not the municipality), kita-apie-save is unmapped (not asked) and so is the declaration period (no note paragraph); the election's own keys — anketa.seimos-nariai and pareiskimai.ar-pasyvioji-rinkimu-teise-neapribota — map to no existing concept. 2026-08-23 for 2004-ep: the 2009 EP paths (the same question set, five years earlier) validated against its complete field (241 records); porinkiminis-numeris is unmapped as for the other pre-2016 results-joined elections — the 2004 rank lives in kandidatavimas.porinkiminisNumerisSarase, a results-tree join outside the normalized layer — and so is the declaration period (no note paragraph).

gimimo-data.note: For the 1996-1998 Seimas archive elections the value is derived from the biography's opening sentence rather than a published field (those pages have none); each such record carries anketa.gimimo-data-saltinis = 'biografijos-tekstas'. Present on 692 of that family's 906 records; a further 157 have only anketa.gimimo-metai (year, never a date).

tautybe.note: Not published in the 2024 and 2025 elections.

visuomenine-veikla.note: 2020-seimo's question wording is wider (scientific + pedagogical activity); the key is shared.

naryste-politinese-organizacijose.note: Three value shapes: plain string (2016 era), free text under .tekstas (2020–2023), record list under .irasai with politine-organizacija/nuo/iki items (2024 on).

iskele.note: Absent from 2019-ep, 2019-prezidento and 2024-ep. On the profile card only for mayoral candidacies in the municipal general elections, and only on a subset of records in 2020-seimo and 2024-seimo (758/1754 and 699/1740); 2023-kovo-5 splits it by role across two keys.

porinkiminis-numeris.note: Absent from the presidential elections, which have no lists.

ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu.label-lt: Ar buvote pripažintas kaltu dėl nusikalstamos veikos
ar-buvote-pripazintas-kaltu.note: 19 of 20 elections; the 2019 presidential questionnaire asks constitutional eligibility questions instead and has no conviction declaration.

teistumo-detales.note: Uniform: one entry per conviction. Entries carry nuosprendzio-data/-valstybe/-institucija everywhere; the 2019/2021 municipal-law entries add the free-text nusikalstama-veika, the Rinkimu kodekso era (2023+) entries add a nusikalstamos-veikos list of structured offence records.

vertybiniai-popieriai-meno-kuriniai-juve.label-lt: Vertybiniai popieriai, meno kūriniai, juvelyriniai dirbiniai
